description: This file defines the SNPreferencesService class, which manages user preferences within the application. It includes methods to get, set, and reload preferences, handles observers for sync and item updates, and integrates with singleton and sync managers.

classes.name: SNPreferencesService
classes.description: Manages user preferences, handles loading, updating, and synchronization of preferences, and responds to application lifecycle events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the preferences service with singleton, item, and sync managers, sets up observers for preferences and sync events.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up observers and references when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles application lifecycle stages, loads preferences when the database is loaded, and triggers notification if preferences are available.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given preference key, returning a default if not set.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a preference value and triggers synchronization and notification.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads preferences from storage if needed, and notifies if preferences have changed.
